op-cognitive-mcp.description: Code-aware cognitive MCP — memory, RAG, identity graph, compliance, context persistence. Requires Qdrant + Voyage API key for full RAG.

op-dbus-compact.description: Compact op-dbus MCP with meta-tools - NOTE: Claude Desktop prefers stdio. Use op-mcp-server binary for native support.

op-dbus-stdio.description: op-dbus MCP via stdio (recommended for Claude Desktop)

_note: Claude Desktop natively supports stdio-based MCP servers. For SSE-based servers, you may need mcp-proxy or similar bridge. Set VOYAGE_API_KEY for full code-RAG. Qdrant must be running for vector search.
